issue.title: The plan feedback replan branch still hand-rolls the family-successor dance instead of calling continue_as_successor
issue.description:
FOUND BY the sase-p8 land agent (2026-08-18) while verifying epic sase-p8 ('sase pipe'). NOT caused by that epic: this call site was simply not in the epic's plan. The epic's own scoping table in plan:202608/agent_pipe.md enumerated four family-successor sites (run_agent_exec_plan_accept.py, run_agent_exec_questions.py, monitor/followup.py, axe/run_agent_retry_spawn.py) and missed this fifth one.

WHAT IS WRONG: epic sase-p8 phase sase-p8.1 extracted the in-process become-the-next-family-member sequence into src/sase/axe/run_agent_successor.py (SuccessorRequest + continue_as_successor), and migrated plan-accept, questions, and the new pipe hand-off onto it. The plan FEEDBACK replan branch in src/sase/axe/run_agent_exec_plan.py (the 'if plan_result.action == \"feedback\"' block, around lines 172-240) still performs the same sequence inline: promote_to_workflow, allocate_agent_family_child_suffix on the '--plan-@' template, set current_role_suffix, bump agent_step, create_followup_artifacts with agent_name_override=plan_chain_agent_name(...), set current_prompt, then _store_followup_prompt_artifact(label='Full feedback prompt'). It is now the only remaining copy.

CONCRETE DIVERGENCE ALREADY PRESENT: the engine bumps state.agent_step FIRST and promotes when the bumped step equals 2; the feedback branch promotes when state.agent_step == 1 and bumps afterwards. Equivalent today, but it is exactly the kind of load-bearing ordering constraint the engine's module docstring was written to stop being re-derived per call site. The feedback branch also allocates its suffix before the step bump, the opposite order from the engine.

SCOPE: replace the inline sequence with a continue_as_successor call taking suffix_template='--plan-@', the feedback relationships block (plan_path, feedback_submitted_at, patch_name, changespec_name, source_plan_agent_name), prompt_artifact_label='Full feedback prompt', and the fallback token the unnamed-agent branch uses today (f'{PLAN_CHAIN_PLAN_SUFFIX}-{state.feedback_round - 1}'). This is a behavior-preserving refactor: the existing plan-feedback suites must pass unmodified, which is the same evidence standard sase-p8.1 held itself to. Note that continue_as_successor's fallback_token path renders a template rather than composing that exact string, so confirm the unnamed-agent naming is preserved or thread it through explicitly.

RELATED CONTEXT: record_workflow_metadata and the feedback_submitted_at meta write stay where they are — only the successor sequencing moves, exactly as the epic did for prompt assembly in plan-accept.
